claim.property: Only the authenticated author can publish, replace or withdraw a complete approved snapshot; draft media are not anonymous public assets.
claim.attacker: Anonymous caller, another signed-in author, hostile origin, or malformed badge payload.
claim.scope: Community routes, ownership checks, private R2 media and explicit publication approval.

principals: Authenticated author with authority over own publications
Server with dedicated Neon and R2 credentials
Public badge text treated as untrusted
boundaries: Anonymous editor to first-party Clerk confirmation
Client intent to server schema and live-session checks
Neon visibility to private R2 object reads

observations.detail: Wrong-owner updates and draft reads rejected; approval gates complete promotion; real OAuth user published both approved badges.
Private review-media reads use Clerk JWT session semantics. Checking live session revocation on each private read remains optional hardening; no anonymous or cross-owner disclosure was observed.

verification.authorized_scope: Owned project and isolated fictional fixtures; real user OAuth and the two explicitly approved sample badges.
commands: Native WebMCP publication and anonymous gallery/remix
verification.cleanup: Disposable lifecycle scripts clean their own fixtures; QA browser publication withdrawn; remaining cleanup recorded separately.

follow_ups: Consider live-session validation for private-review media reads if immediate revocation is required.
